## Rajasthan Vidyut Vibhag LDC Syllabus 2026

Rajasthan State Power Sector Companies (RVUNL, KVVNL, JDVVNL, AVVNL) have published the comprehensive syllabus and selection scheme for Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Junior Assistant positions for the year 2026.

### Exam Scheme & Pattern
- **Phase I Written Test:** Objective Multiple Choice Questions.
- **Subjects Covered:** Reasoning & Mental Ability, Mathematics, General Knowledge & Everyday Science, Hindi, and English.
- **Phase II Test:** Typing Speed & Efficiency Test in Hindi and English on Computer.

### How to Prepare
Candidates are advised to review the official syllabus structure, focus on Rajasthan GK, current affairs, standard secondary level mathematics, and practice computer typing test skills regularly.

faqs.question: Is there a typing test for Rajasthan Vidyut Vibhag LDC?

## Rajasthan Vidyut Vibhag LDC Recruitment 2026 - Exam Pattern & Detailed Syllabus

Rajasthan State Electricity Companies (RVUNL, AVVNL, JDVVNL, JVVNL) have released the syllabus and recruitment guidelines for Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and Commercial Assistant Grade II posts.

- **Type:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
- **Language:** Bilingual (English & Hindi)
- **Negative Marking:** 0.25 marks deduction for each wrong answer.

#### Subject-wise Mark Distribution:
- General Reasoning & Mental Ability
- General Knowledge & Everyday Science
- Mathematics (10th Standard level)
- General Hindi & General English
